_schema.produced_by: manual adjudication of the two heuristic categories with the highest error rate, ~70%-depth run
_schema.backs: the Section 5.2 / Appendix B.6 statement that the original six-category heuristic over-assigned topic drift and catastrophic redirect
_schema.scope: F-mix and F-attenuate only. The source review also covered F-transplant, which was removed from Paper 1 at v30 and is excluded here.
_schema.important: Corrected 2026-08-10 after auditing the source scripts. These are NOT 739 hand-read items. Of the F-mix/F-attenuate records here, only 8 carry a hand-authored label (note begins 'MANUAL:') and 58 more were resolved by a secondary rule pass (note begins 'RESOLVED:'); the remaining 673 are the rule-based reclassifier's output. Across the full source review (which also covered F-transplant) only 30 of 1,861 items were hand-assigned, in resolve_review_items.py. Treat this file as 'the rule pass, plus a small hand-adjudicated tail', not as a manual re-coding.

fields.jaccard: the word-overlap score the heuristic used

how_to_tell.RESOLVED:: assigned by a secondary rule pass over review-flagged items (58 records here)
